content.text: Aprendemos uma regra muito importante do inglês na aula passada. Sabe explicar por que devemos colocar um -s nessa frase: He works a lot!
💡 Se ainda não ficou claro, revise a aula passada e use uma abordagem diferente para a explicação.
No final desta aula, você será capaz de:
Compreender diálogos curtos em inglês que falam sobre direções.
A compreensão auditiva é fundamental para se comunicar de forma eficaz. É só depois de aprender a ouvir que vai conseguir aprender a falar.
Traduza as palavras a seguir e faça uma frase com cada uma delas
Take the first / second / third / right
Go right / left / straight at the light / corner / stop sign
Turn right / left at the light / corner / stop sign
Get on the bus / subway at 12th Ave. / Whitman Street / Yellow Lane
Follow the signs for the museum / exhibition center / exit
Which building is the grocery store?
Which building is the post office?
Estudem os textos abaixo como já foi mostrado em aulas anteriores.
Linda, do you know how to get to Samson's and Co.? I've never been there before.
Are you driving or taking the subway?
Take the blue line from 14th Ave. and change to the gray line at Andrew Square. Get off at 83rd street.
Just a minute, let me write this down.
Take the blue line from 14th Ave. and change to the gray line at Andrew Square. Get off at 83rd street. Got it?
Yes, thanks. Now, once I get to Andrew Square, how do I proceed?
Once you're on 83rd street, go straight, past the bank. Take the second left and continue straight. It's across the street from Jack's Bar.
Once you're on 83rd street, go straight, past the bank. Take the second left and continue going straight. It's across the street from Jack's Bar.
Thanks, Linda. How long does it take to get there?
It takes about a half-hour. When is your meeting?
It's at 10 a.m. I'll leave at 9:30.
That's a busy time. You should leave at 9.
I'm fine. I have a question. Do you have a moment?
Certainly, how can I help you?
I'm driving to the conference center later today. Could you give me directions?
OK, take a left onto Bethany street and drive to the freeway entrance. Take the freeway toward Portland.
How far is it to the conference center from my home?
It's about 20 miles. Continue on the freeway to exit 23. Take the exit and turn right onto Broadway at the stoplight.
Let me repeat that. Take the freeway to exit 23 and turn right onto Broadway.
That's right. Continue on Broadway for about two miles and then turn left onto 16th Ave.
On 16th Ave., take the second right into the conference center.
Yes, it's very easy to get to.
How long does it take to get there?
If there's no traffic, about 25 minutes. In heavy traffic, it takes about 45 minutes.
I'm leaving at 10 in the morning, so the traffic shouldn't be so bad.
Yes, that's right. Can I help you with anything else?
No that's it. Thanks for your help.
Aprendemos expressões muito importantes sobre direções e aprendemos várias palavras novas. Consegue citar 5 palavras novas que aprendeu hoje?
Identificar palavras de direções em um diálogo?
Explicar como ir da sua casa ao mercado mais próximo
Dia 1 - Ouça os vídeos novamente e anote palavras-chave.
Dia 2 - Repita os diálogos em voz alta. (Pesquise Shadowing novamente)
Dia 3 - Fazer o homework usando o método de estudar textos
Dia 4 - Gravar um áudio explicando como ir até o hospital.
Dia 5 - Revisar aula 23 sobre Locais e direções
Dia 6 - Revisar textos vistos em aula
Excuse me, can you help me? I'm looking for the museum.
Certainly, it's about a five-minute walk.
Maybe I should call a taxi.
Thank you. That's very kind of you.
Not at all. Now, go along this street to the traffic lights. Do you see them?
Right, at the traffic lights, turn left into Queen Mary Ave.
Right. Go straight. Take the second left and enter Museum Drive.
OK. Queen Mary Ave., straight on and then the third left, Museum Drive.
Ah, right. The second street on my left.
Right. Just follow Museum Drive and the museum is at the end of the road.
Great. Thanks again for your help.
Could you go to the supermarket and buy some food? There's nothing to eat in the house!
Sure, but I don't know the way. We've just moved in.
I'll give you directions. Not to worry.
At the end of the street, take a right. Then drive two miles to White Ave. After that, it's another mile to...
Let me write this down. I won't remember it!
OK. First, take a right at the end of the street.
Next, drive two miles to White Ave.
Two miles to White Ave. After that?
The supermarket is on the left, next to the bank.
How far is it after I turn on to 14th Street?
It's not far, maybe about 200 yards.
OK. Great. Is there anything special you want?
No, just the usual. Well, if you could get some beer that would be great!
